lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in at least five identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with spot diameter increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of coordinate nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, lower-intensity spots compared to the lateral flank patterning.
